decision.status: Controlled proof is justified; clinical efficacy and fundable product differentiation remain unproven
decision.reason_no_pooling: Selected positive case reports have no consecutive treated denominator; induction and maintenance differ; the nine-patient preprint has inaccessible participant detail and unresolved overlap.
supportable_value: Potential reduction in rescue treatment and functional burden
unsupported_claims: Restored ATP2C1 function in treated patients
Established HHD-specific systemic safety or exposure
Validated HHD minimal clinically important difference

cases.prior_treatment_context: Steroids, antibiotics, antifungals, intralesional triamcinolone, glycopyrrolate and CO2 laser inadequately effective; repeated upadacitinib response/relapse history.
cases.background_treatment: Upadacitinib 15 mg daily during successful combination induction; then ruxolitinib alone for five months
cases.treatment_lineage: Upadacitinib alone produced earlier remissions lasting two and three months. Later 15 mg retreatment failed; 30 mg caused dizziness/falls. Reintroduced 15 mg plus ruxolitinib induced remission. Groin-only cream continued for five months; untreated back flared and improved when oral upadacitinib restarted.

response.measure: Remission followed by flare on untreated back

cases.infection_assessment: COVID-19 preceded an earlier flare; no topical-treatment infection screen stated
cases.safety: Dizziness and falls occurred with oral upadacitinib 30 mg; do not assign these to topical ruxolitinib
cases.interpretation: Suggestive local maintenance after mixed induction; untreated-back relapse is not failure of cream applied to groin. Regional biology and systemic carryover prevent causal comparison.

cases.diagnostic_evidence: Previously diagnosed HHD; no patient-specific biopsy/genetic result provided in case narrative

cases.interpretation: Additional exact-strength case; complete clearance, sustained remission interval and quantified benefit not established.

ceccacci_preprint.mechanistic_abstract: Bulk, single-cell and spatial multiomic analyses describe IFN-associated inflammatory programs in several skin compartments.
ceccacci_preprint.clinical_abstract: Rapid sustained improvement, re-epithelialization and symptom/quality-of-life improvement reported in nine refractory patients.
ceccacci_preprint.causal_interpretation: Association and uncontrolled treatment concordance; no verified IFN-selective perturbation, genotype repair or patient-level controlled response.

derm101_control_audit.IGSA_definition: Primary-lesion five-point scale: 0 clear, 1 almost clear, 2 mild, 3 moderate, 4 severe
derm101_control_audit.efficacy_population: Randomized, at least one dose, baseline and at least one postbaseline IGSA; early toxicity discontinuations included even without postbaseline IGSA
derm101_control_audit.inference_limit: A small different-drug trial illustrates spontaneous/background/placebo-associated improvement; it cannot estimate ruxolitinib effect, supply a universal placebo rate or validate an HHD MCID.

gaumond_biopsy_audit.replicate_structure: One section per marker (IL-4 and IL-13), plus no-antibody control per biopsy; thousands of cells/section are nested observations
gaumond_biopsy_audit.donor_lineage: Paper describes seven validated HHD cases. Table provides sample numbers; same sex/age pairs may or may not be repeated donors. Do not invent a reduced donor count or treat sections as patients.
gaumond_biopsy_audit.interpretation: Associative inflammatory evidence; incompletely matched controls and demographic summary discrepancy. No treated-ruxolitinib experiment or IFN-selective causal test.

mechanistic_citation_correction.downstream_claim: Jobe says anti-IL-6 and anti-IL-8 restored ATP2C1 expression
mechanistic_citation_correction.primary_result: Mayuzumi 2005: anti-IL-6 prevented UVB-related ATP2C1 mRNA suppression; anti-IL-8 slightly accelerated suppression

endpoint_design.purpose: Falsifiable local benefit and maintenance-value proof, followed by product differentiation
endpoint_design.suggested_first_controlled_window: Approximately 8–12 weeks, harmonized with integrated proof; investigator/statistical planning choice, not a validated HHD standard
endpoint_design.extension: Approximately 12–24 weeks to observe maintained control, exposure burden and recurrence; proposed rather than published evidence
endpoint_design.unit: Patient; lesions and visits are nested or paired observations, not independent participants
preferred_lesion_measures: Sustained complete or near-complete epithelialization at prespecified visits
preferred_patient_measures: Chosen functional limitation such as walking, work or sleep
Treatment burden and flare-free or well-controlled days
endpoint_design.baseline: Document recent and prospective trajectory, historical flare duration, stable background care and triggers without requiring avoidable untreated pain or withdrawal
endpoint_design.split_body_limits: Anatomic imbalance, spontaneous regional differences, barrier changes, systemic spillover and transfer can bias treatment contrasts; whole-person quality of life is not site-specific
endpoint_design.crossover_limit: Healing and disease-state changes can outlast drug clearance; no invented pharmacokinetic washout or withdrawal to force a relapse
endpoint_design.MCID_status: No HHD-specific validated MCID identified in this bounded review; do not import AD or generic dermatology thresholds as disease-validated
endpoint_design.failure_rule: No reproducible improvement in the intended meaningful value after credible exposure and controlled assessment, or toxicity/burden erasing benefit
endpoint_design.mechanism_gate: Clinical benefit need not require proof of genetic correction; IFN biomarker or barrier claims need separate validated mechanistic endpoints
integration_refinements: Primary estimand selected before outcomes, with explicit rescue/missingness treatment
Maintenance responders and all initially randomized participants retain separate denominators
Allowed background care is specified; historical biologic/other-JAK combinations do not automatically define a new protocol
